courses.title: Fusion 360 Essentials
courses.name: Fusion 360
courses.description: Cloud-based 3D CAD/CAM software for product design and manufacturing, combining industrial and mechanical design with simulation and collaboration tools.

courses.title: AutoCAD Fundamentals
courses.name: AutoCAD
courses.description: Industry-standard 2D drafting and 3D modeling software used for architectural, engineering, and construction design documentation. Learn precision drawing, layout planning, and presentation tools for effective design communication.
learningOutcomes: Using layers, blocks, annotations, and dimensioning
Creating templates and working with layouts
Plotting and printing drawings to scale

courses.title: AutoCAD Electrical Design
courses.name: AutoCAD Electrical
courses.description: Autodesk’s specialized toolset for electrical control designers. It builds upon AutoCAD's core drafting tools with features tailored to electrical design, helping automate control system design, schematic creation, panel layout, and  drawings.
curriculum: Creating Electrical Schematic and Wiring Diagrams
Electrical Symbols, Components, and Wire Numbering
learningOutcomes: Creating and modifying electrical control systems
Create schematics, wiring diagrams, and other electrical drawings

courses.title: BIM for Architectural Design
courses.name: BIM Architecture
courses.description: Master the integration of Building Information Modeling (BIM) in architectural design. This course focuses on creating intelligent 3D models that serve as comprehensive digital representations of physical and functional characteristics of buildings, enabling better design decisions, improved collaboration, and more efficient project delivery.
curriculum: BIM Fundamentals and Workflows in Architecture
Parametric Design and Building Performance Analysis
Interior Design and Space Planning with BIM
Collaboration and Coordination with Other Disciplines
learningOutcomes: Develop comprehensive architectural BIM models from concept to construction
Implement sustainable design principles through BIM analysis
Create detailed construction documentation and schedules
Visualize and present architectural designs effectively
Coordinate with structural and MEP teams using BIM collaboration tools
Optimize building performance through data-driven design decisions
prerequisites: Basic understanding of architectural design principles
Familiarity with CAD or 3D modeling concepts

courses.title: BIM for Civil Infrastructure
courses.name: BIM Infrastructure
courses.description: Civil engineering design software for roads, land development, and infrastructure projects. Combines CAD drafting with intelligent 3D design and documentation tools.
courses.targetAudience: Civil Engineers, Infrastructure Designers, BIM Specialists (CIV/INFRA)
learningOutcomes: Generate corridor models for roads and highways
prerequisites: Basic understanding of civil engineering concepts
Experience with infrastructure design is helpful

courses.title: BIM for Construction Management
courses.name: BIM Construction
courses.description: Leverage BIM technology to revolutionize construction management and execution. This course focuses on 4D construction sequencing, 5D cost management, and field coordination using BIM, enabling more efficient project delivery, reduced errors, and better collaboration between all stakeholders in the construction process.
courses.targetAudience: Construction Managers, Site Engineers, BIM Coordinators (CONST)
curriculum: BIM in Construction: Processes and Benefits
Clash Detection and Resolution in Construction
BIM for Prefabrication and Modular Construction
learningOutcomes: Implement BIM for construction planning and scheduling
Perform accurate quantity takeoffs and cost estimations
Resolve constructability issues through clash detection
Utilize BIM for field operations and quality control
Manage as-built documentation and handover processes

courses.title: Revit MEP Essentials
courses.name: Revit MEP
courses.description: BIM solution for mechanical, electrical, and plumbing (MEP) engineers. Supports 3D modeling and system analysis for HVAC, piping, fire protection, and electrical systems.
learningOutcomes: Designing HVAC, electrical, and plumbing systems in 3D
Coordinating with architectural and structural models
Using templates and families for efficient workflows
prerequisites: Understanding of mechanical or electrical principles

courses.title: Revit Structure Fundamentals
courses.name: Revit Structure
courses.description: BIM solution for structural engineers to design, analyze, and document structural systems with accuracy. Supports concrete, steel, and composite structure workflows with parametric modeling.
curriculum: Modeling Structural Columns, Beams, and Foundations
learningOutcomes: Modeling structural elements: beams, columns, slabs, walls, and foundations
Adding reinforcement details to concrete elements
Working with structural steel connections and trusses
Coordinating with architectural and MEP models
Generating structural drawings, details, and schedules
Exporting models to structural analysis software like STAAD.Pro

courses.title: Civil 3D Essentials
courses.name: Civil 3D
courses.description: Civil engineering design software for roads, land development, and infrastructure projects. Combines CAD drafting with intelligent 3D design and documentation tools.
learningOutcomes: Pipe networks for stormwater and sewage

courses.title: 3DS Max for Architectural Visualization
courses.name: 3DS Max
courses.description: 3ds Max is a professional 3D modeling, animation, and rendering software used for creating 3D visualizations, animations, and models in architecture, games, and film industries. This course covers essential techniques for modeling, lighting, rendering, and animation to bring your creative projects to life.

courses.title: Navisworks Coordination
courses.name: Navisworks
courses.description: Project review software for coordination, 4D simulation, and clash detection in BIM workflows. Enhances collaboration across architecture, engineering, and construction.
curriculum: Working with NWD, NWF, and NWC Files
learningOutcomes: Aggregating models from Revit, Civil 3D, etc.
prerequisites: Experience with CAD or Revit preferred

courses.title: InfraWorks Fundamentals
courses.name: InfraWorks
courses.description: powerful BIM tool used for the design and planning of infrastructure projects. This course will teach you how to create 3D models of real-world environments and integrate design concepts into a unified model for analysis, visualization, and project collaboration.
learningOutcomes: Conceptual designs for roadways, sites, rail, water, and other infrastructure projects

courses.title: Maya for Architectural Visualization
courses.name: Maya
courses.description: A comprehensive 3D animation software widely used in gaming, film, and motion graphics. This course covers essential skills in 3D modeling, texturing, lighting, rendering, and animation to help you bring your digital creations to life.
curriculum: Introduction to Maya Interface and Tools

courses.title: Microstation Fundamentals
courses.name: OpenRoads Designer
courses.description: Civil infrastructure design software for roadways, offering 3D modeling, terrain modeling, drainage, and corridor modeling in a single platform.
learningOutcomes: Survey data import and terrain modeling

courses.title: OpenFlows WaterGEMS Essentials
courses.name: OpenFlows WaterGEMS
courses.description: Water distribution modeling software that helps engineers plan, design, and optimize water systems with advanced hydraulic modeling capabilities.

courses.title: OpenFlows SewerGEMS Fundamentals
courses.name: OpenFlows SewerGEMS
courses.description: Advanced software for planning, design, and analysis of sanitary and combined sewer systems, using hydraulic and hydrologic modeling tools.
curriculum: Overview of Sewer Systems and Modeling

courses.title: STAAD Pro Advanced Analysis
courses.name: STAAD Pro
courses.description: Structural analysis and design software for buildings, bridges, and towers. Enables accurate modeling, analysis under load conditions, and design as per global codes.
learningOutcomes: Defining various loads (dead, live, wind, seismic)
Designing RCC and steel members as per IS codes
Generating detailed reports and structural drawings

courses.title: MicroStation Fundamentals
courses.name: MicroStation
courses.description: powerful CAD software used for design, drafting, and modeling in architecture, engineering, and construction. This course will guide you through the essentials of 2D and 3D design, enabling you to create and manage designs for infrastructure projects.
curriculum: Managing Design Files and CAD Standards
learningOutcomes: 2D and 3D drawings for Buildings and Infrastructure
Designing and documenting of Roads and Bridges

courses.title: SolidWorks 3D Design
courses.name: SOLIDWORKS
courses.description: 3D CAD software for mechanical design and product development. Offers powerful modeling, simulation, and documentation tools for engineers and designers.
learningOutcomes: Drawing sheets with dimensions and BOM
Intro to simulation and design validation

courses.title: Fusion 360 Product Design
courses.name: Fusion 360
courses.description: Cloud-based CAD tools integrating parametric modeling, generative design, and CNC programming for product development.
learningOutcomes: Design complete products from concept to manufacture

courses.title: BIM for Infrastructure Projects
courses.name: BIM for Infrastructure
courses.description: Introduces BIM methodologies for roads, bridges, and utilities, including 4D scheduling and clash detection.

courses.title: BIM Construction
courses.name: BIM Construction
courses.description: The main objectives of BIM in construction are to improve project performance, enhance collaboration, and create more efficient and cost-effective processes. This course covers advanced BIM methodologies specifically tailored for construction management, including 4D scheduling, 5D cost estimation, and field coordination. Learn how to leverage BIM for clash detection, quantity takeoffs, and construction sequencing to optimize project delivery.
courses.targetAudience: Construction Managers, Civil Engineers, BIM Modelers (CIV/CONST)
curriculum: Introduction to BIM in Construction Management
Case Studies of Successful BIM Implementation
learningOutcomes: Develop comprehensive 4D construction schedules integrated with BIM models
Generate accurate quantity takeoffs and cost estimates from BIM data
Implement effective clash detection and resolution workflows
Utilize mobile BIM solutions for field coordination and quality control
Create as-built documentation for facility management and operations
Apply lean construction principles through BIM integration
prerequisites: Basic understanding of BIM concepts and Revit/Navisworks
Familiarity with construction documentation and processes

courses.title: SketchUp for Architectural Design
courses.name: SketchUp
courses.description: Intuitive 3D modeling software used for architectural and interior design visualization. Ideal for conceptual models, landscape, and furniture design.
learningOutcomes: Creating and editing 3D models from scratch
Working with groups, components, and layers
Exporting models for rendering and documentation

courses.title: V-Ray for Architectural Rendering
courses.name: V-Ray
courses.description: V-Ray is a high-quality rendering engine used in architecture, product design, and animation for creating photorealistic visualizations. This course focuses on integrating V-Ray with  SketchUp for lighting, materials, rendering techniques, and post-production.
curriculum: Using Render Elements and Post Effects
learningOutcomes: Realistic renderings of buildings, interiors, and exteriors
Visual effects, animations, and other cinematic content
Transform 3D scenes into visually stunning artwork

courses.title: Lumion Real-time Visualization
courses.name: Lumion
courses.description: Architectural visualization software for creating high-quality renders, animations, and walkthroughs. Known for its intuitive interface and real-time rendering capabilities.
learningOutcomes: Rendering images and videos in HD

courses.title: Enscape for Real-time Rendering
courses.name: Enscape
courses.description: Real-time visualization and rendering plugin for Revit, SketchUp, Rhino, and ArchiCAD. Helps architects and designers create immersive walkthroughs and photo-realistic outputs.
learningOutcomes: Integrating Enscape with Revit or SketchUp
prerequisites: Experience with Revit, SketchUp, or other CAD software

courses.title: Primavera P6 Project Management
courses.name: Primavera
courses.description: Project management software used in construction and engineering to plan, schedule, and control large-scale projects with complex resource and cost tracking.

courses.title: Rhino 3D Modeling

courses.description: Rhino is a versatile 3D modeling software, especially used in architecture and industrial design for its precision and NURBS modeling capabilities. Grasshopper, its visual programming plugin, enables parametric design and algorithmic modeling.

courses.title: Grasshopper Parametric Design
courses.name: Grasshopper
courses.description: Visual programming language for Rhino that enables parametric and algorithmic design, allowing for complex form generation and design exploration.

courses.title: Photoshop for Architectural Visualization

Creating posters, banners, and digital graphics
Exporting designs for print, web, and social media

courses.title: Illustrator for Technical Drawing
courses.name: Illustrator
courses.description: Vector graphics software for creating logos, illustrations, and typography. Industry standard for digital drawing and design.
learningOutcomes: Designing logos, icons, and other branding elements
Creating designs for print materials like posters, flyers, brochures, and business cards
Designing eye-catching graphics for social media platforms, including posts, stories, and ads

courses.title: ETABS Structural Analysis
courses.name: ETABS
courses.description: Structural analysis and design software used for buildings, offering integrated modeling, analysis, and design of concrete and steel structures.

learningOutcomes: Interpretation of results and report creation

courses.title: MS Project for Project Management
